units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 6">Lev. R. s. 6</cite>, v. <cite ref="C00701"><he>גִּיֵּיד</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 471:4">Yalk. ib. 471</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 471:4">ib.</cite> <he>שאין הכל אלא מן הק׳</he> it is all the fault of the receivers.

senses.gloss: one who assumes another man’s obligation unconditionally, differ. fr. עָרֵב; surety.
units: B. Bath. 173ᵇ bot. וק׳ אע״פ … מן הק׳ but in the case of a Ḳabb’lan, even if the debtor has property, the creditor may sue the surety.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 174a:5">Ib. 174ᵃ</cite> <he>תן לו ואני ק׳ … לשון קבלנות הן</he> when one says, give him (not, lend him), and I am surety, give him, and I will pay …, all these phrases mean absolute assumption of the obligation; a. e.

senses.gloss: contractor, a hired man paid for certain work when it is done, contrad. from day-laborer; also tenant of land at a fixed rent.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 7:3">Tosef. B. Mets. VII, 3</cite>, v. <cite ref="S00078"><he>קַבְּלָנוּת</he></cite>.
Shebi. III, 9 והק׳ מביא מכל מקום and the building contractor may take stones (during the Sabbatical year) from any place; [oth. opin.: the tenant etc.]—Pl. קַבְּלָנִים, קַבְּלָנִין.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 11b">M. Kat. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>הק׳</he>; Y. ib. III, 82ᵇ bot. <he>קַבָּלָיו</he> (from <cite ref="S00062"><he>קַבָּל</he></cite>) his laborers hired for a certain work.
